name: Repo Triage and Digest
description: Two-stage GitHub intake: GitDiagram links for structure, then a size-capped Gitingest digest for model context.

inputs.localRoot: string, optional directory to digest offline
inputs.authToken: string, optional, memory only, never returned

outputs.ingestionDigest: summary, tree, pruned paths, and file text when localRoot is set

tooltip: Triage a GitHub repository with GitDiagram, then extract a capped digest for any model.
